# iscc-web

> Microservice for generating International Standard Content Codes (ISCC, ISO 24138) for media files.

iscc-web wraps the ISCC reference software (iscc-sdk) in an async REST API: upload a media file
and receive its ISCC-CODE together with extracted metadata, ISCC-UNITs, and granular content
fingerprints (simprints). The service also embeds metadata into media files, decodes ISCC codes
into human-readable form, and generates plaintext simprints for search services. Uploaded files
are automatically deleted after a configurable timeout. A public instance with a Vue.js demo
frontend runs at https://iscc.io, with interactive API documentation at https://iscc.io/docs.

Run: `docker run -p 8000:8000 ghcr.io/iscc/iscc-web:main`

- [Source code](https://github.com/iscc/iscc-web)
- [Public instance](https://iscc.io)
- [Full documentation](https://web.iscc.codes/llms-full.txt)
